research_question: Can independent experimental band-gap knowledge improve power-conversion-efficiency prediction in chemically held-out perovskite families when recipient band gaps are never used as model inputs?

already_inspected: no row-level or aggregate power-conversion-efficiency transfer contrast

recipient.target: default power conversion efficiency in percent
forbidden_predictors: any target-derived aggregate containing the held-out entry

experimental_text_mined.gate: DOI present; eV; 0.20-6.00 eV; extracted range width <=0.50 eV; Snowball=true; confidence>=0.80
experimental_text_mined.aggregation: median within DOI before median across DOI
training_exclusions: every exact recipient composition for the strict generalization model

computed_hse.calibration: Huber regression to DOI-clean replicated experimental source cards on exact source-source composition overlap
computed_hse.eligibility_contract: available only for target compositions without C, H, or N and within the 95th percentile of HSE source-source nearest-neighbor distance

curated_retrieval.route: use exact independent composition evidence when available; otherwise use the chemistry-contract generalization prediction

source_skill_gate.endpoint: recipient band gaps marked as directly measured by absorption, Tauc, EQE, IPCE, UPS, UV, or photoluminescence methods
source_skill_gate.downstream_rule: No photovoltaic outcome benchmark may be interpreted for a donor policy that fails this gate.

chemical_ood_split.family_key: sets of A-site, B-site, and C-site ion names, ignoring coefficients
chemical_ood_split.core_definition: Most frequent eligible families accumulated in descending frequency until they cover at least 60 percent of valid rows.
chemical_ood_split.distance: Euclidean distance between family median element-fraction vectors and the closest core-family centroid.
chemical_ood_split.test_selection: Non-core eligible families ranked by decreasing distance then increasing frequency and lexical family key; add complete families until at least 20 percent of eligible rows are selected.
chemical_ood_split.literature_exclusion: Every DOI represented in the selected OOD families is removed in full from recipient training, even if that DOI also reports a core family.
chemical_ood_split.test_rows: Only rows belonging to selected OOD families and valid target range.

recipient_features.composition: 118 element fractions plus eight deterministic composition descriptors
recipient_features.site_tokens: A/B/C ion identities and rounded coefficients
recipient_features.categorical_encoding: FeatureHasher with 256 dimensions fit without outcomes
recipient_features.missingness: explicit missing tokens and numeric missingness indicators

recipient_model.budget_unit: rows sampled as intact DOI groups with deterministic near-target selection

inference.primary_metric: relative OOD RMSE gain versus paired target-only model
inference.resampling: paired cluster bootstrap over OOD families and DOIs with 10000 replicates
inference.multiple_comparisons: Holm correction across the four real borrowing policies within the primary budget

claim_guard: A passing policy demonstrates retrospective improvement on a declared chemical-OOD benchmark. It does not establish prospective laboratory discovery or universal transfer. A failed policy remains part of the borrowing-map boundary and cannot be replaced after outcome inspection.
